Trace, implement and test: leetcode53 maximum subarray

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int maxSubArray(vector<int>& nums) {
        int len = nums.size();
        if(len == 0) return 0;
        if(len == 1) return nums[0];

        int maxSum = INT_MIN;
        int currentSum = 0;
        for(int i = 0; i<len; i++)
        {
            currentSum += nums[i];
            if(currentSum > maxSum)   /* 将最大和更新为当前和  */
                maxSum = currentSum;
            
            if(currentSum < 0)
                currentSum = 0;  /* 若currentSum=0，此时什么都不做，等价于置为0. */
        }

        return maxSum;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {-2,1,-3,4,-1,2,1,-5,4};
    int res = sol.maxSubArray(nums);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
